message.content:
To log in to your **Wells Fargo credit card** account, go to Wells Fargo’s website and select **Sign On**, then enter your **username** and **password**.[1][2]

If you are not enrolled yet, Wells Fargo’s online banking flow typically includes an **Enroll** option to set up access using your credit card and personal information.[2]

If you need help or cannot sign in, the safest option is to use Wells Fargo’s official site or the phone number on the back of your card rather than third-party pages.[1][2]

answer_text:
To log in to your **Wells Fargo credit card** account, go to Wells Fargo’s website and select **Sign On**, then enter your **username** and **password**.[1][2]

If you are not enrolled yet, Wells Fargo’s online banking flow typically includes an **Enroll** option to set up access using your credit card and personal information.[2]

If you need help or cannot sign in, the safest option is to use Wells Fargo’s official site or the phone number on the back of your card rather than third-party pages.[1][2]
